entities.summary: The Moulay Abdallah Mosque or Mosque of Moulay Abdallah is a major mosque and royal necropolis complex situated in the center of the Moulay Abdallah district in Fes el-Jdid, the historic palace-city and citadel in Fez, Morocco. It was founded by the Alawi sultan Moulay Abdallah who is buried in the adjoining necropolis along with later members of the dynasty.
